name: Base Game Vanilla House
author: MadamRedo
style: Stepped five-part modern farmhouse in blue-white painted brick: glass-box greenhouse, tall front gable with a dark board panel, flat-roofed box, front-gabled living wing under a tan-brick chimney and a lattice-canopied east entry, behind a serpentine gravel walk, deep fern, lavender and hydrangea beds and a timber-edged lap pool
